item.title: Version 1.3.92
item.description:
- New neon-glass design system: frosted-glass keys with a bright top edge and soft shadow, dark inset wells they sit in, and a lit-tube neon rim (colored glow, tight bloom, hot white core) that pools around the bottom-left corner.
- Applied across the app in the photo-driven accent color: the selected sidebar item, home action tiles (Publish is a bright glowing key), status chips, gallery cards (rim brightens and rotates on hover), the Publish Site / Save buttons and the ⌘K palette.
